passages.note: Clarifies the knowledge requirement for prohibited-persons (felons, outstanding-warrant subjects) firearm possession crimes; does not speak to ownership bans, assault weapons, background checks, or carry permits.

rows.reasoning: SB 723 (2019-2020), authored by Jones, amends the prohibited-persons firearm statutes to require knowledge of an outstanding warrant; it says nothing about "Ban civilian firearm ownership", "Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons", "universal background checks", or carry-permit rules, the clauses that separate the gun-policy rungs, so it is adjacent and establishes no rung.
needs_source: A vote, sponsorship, or own-words statement by Jones addressing civilian firearm ownership bans, assault-style weapon restrictions, universal background checks, or carry-permit rules
